import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch, FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Tufte RC ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TUFTE_RC = {
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Palatino", "Palatino Linotype", "Georgia", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "font.size": 11,
    "figure.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "figure.dpi": 150,
    "axes.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "axes.edgecolor": "#cccccc",
    "axes.linewidth": 0.5,
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "axes.grid": False,
    "savefig.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.25,
}
plt.rcParams.update(TUFTE_RC)

COLORS = {
    "bg":            "#fffff8",
    "text":          "#111111",
    "text_secondary":"#555555",
    "text_tertiary": "#999999",
    "axis":          "#cccccc",
    "source":        "#4e79a7",
    "ingestion":     "#76b7b2",
    "bronze":        "#b5813a",
    "silver":        "#7a8fa6",
    "gold":          "#b8860b",
    "consumption":   "#c44b4b",
    "governance":    "#6b4c9a",
}

mode_colors = {"streaming": "#4e79a7", "batch": "#76b7b2", "cdc": "#f28e2b"}

# ── Figure & axes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 12))
fig.patch.set_facecolor(COLORS["bg"])

# We use a single axes with a coordinate system [0,100] x [0,100]
ax = fig.add_axes([0.01, 0.01, 0.98, 0.84])
ax.set_xlim(0, 100)
ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
ax.axis("off")

# ── Coordinate system ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Y: 0=bottom, 100=top
# Zones:  header band: y=88–96
#         node area:   y=20–86
#         gov band:    y=7–18
#         vol arrow:   y=3–6
LAYER_X = {
    "source":      9,
    "ingestion":   24,
    "bronze":      39,
    "silver":      55,
    "gold":        70,
    "consumption": 87,
}
NODE_AREA_TOP    = 85
NODE_AREA_BOTTOM = 22
NODE_H = 5.8
GOV_Y   = 12.5   # centre of governance strip
GOV_H   = 8.5

# ── Node data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sources = [
    ("IoT Sensors",     450),
    ("App Logs",        320),
    ("Web Clickstream", 210),
    ("NoSQL Stores",    140),
    ("ERP System",      120),
    ("Legacy RDBMS",     95),
    ("CRM Platform",     85),
    ("Social Media",     60),
    ("File Shares",      45),
    ("Market Data",      35),
]

ingestion = [
    ("Stream Ingestion", 980),
    ("Batch Ingestion",  520),
    ("CDC Connector",     60),
]

bronze = [
    ("Raw Log Data",     530),
    ("Raw IoT Events",   450),
    ("Raw Transactions", 300),
    ("Raw DB Snapshots", 185),
    ("Raw External",      95),
]

silver = [
    ("Cleaned IoT Metrics",      180),
    ("Enriched Transactions",    110),
    ("Sessionized Clicks",        90),
    ("Unified Customer 360",      45),
    ("Norm. Market Data",         20),
]

gold = [
    ("Anomaly Features",   12),
    ("Revenue Aggregates",  8),
    ("Product Perf. KPIs",  5),
    ("Marketing Attr.",     4),
    ("Customer LTV",        3),
]

consumption = [
    ("Executive Dashboards",  "BI"),
    ("Ad-hoc SQL Analytics",  "BI"),
    ("ML Training Pipelines", "ML"),
    ("ML Serving Endpoints",  "ML"),
    ("Data API Services",     "API"),
    ("Reverse ETL to SaaS",   "Reverse ETL"),
]

# ── Layout function ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def layout_column(items, cx, y_top, y_bot, node_h, node_w=11):
    """Evenly space nodes in a column from y_top down to y_bot."""
    n = len(items)
    total_space = y_top - y_bot
    spacing = (total_space - n * node_h) / max(n - 1, 1)
    nodes = []
    for i, item in enumerate(items):
        label = item[0]
        val   = item[1] if len(item) > 1 else None
        cy    = y_top - node_h / 2 - i * (node_h + spacing)
        nodes.append({"label": label, "val": val, "cx": cx, "cy": cy,
                      "w": node_w, "h": node_h})
    return nodes

src_nodes = layout_column(sources,     LAYER_X["source"],      NODE_AREA_TOP, NODE_AREA_BOTTOM, NODE_H, node_w=11)
ing_nodes = layout_column(ingestion,   LAYER_X["ingestion"],   NODE_AREA_TOP - 10, NODE_AREA_BOTTOM + 20, NODE_H + 1, node_w=12)
brz_nodes = layout_column(bronze,      LAYER_X["bronze"],      NODE_AREA_TOP - 2,  NODE_AREA_BOTTOM + 10, NODE_H, node_w=11)
slv_nodes = layout_column(silver,      LAYER_X["silver"],      NODE_AREA_TOP - 5,  NODE_AREA_BOTTOM + 12, NODE_H, node_w=11)
gld_nodes = layout_column(gold,        LAYER_X["gold"],        NODE_AREA_TOP - 8,  NODE_AREA_BOTTOM + 18, NODE_H, node_w=11)
con_nodes = layout_column(consumption, LAYER_X["consumption"], NODE_AREA_TOP - 3,  NODE_AREA_BOTTOM + 10, NODE_H, node_w=11)

# ── Draw helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_node(ax, node, layer_color, fontsize=8):
    cx, cy, w, h = node["cx"], node["cy"], node["w"], node["h"]
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2, cy - h/2), w, h,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.25",
                          facecolor=layer_color, edgecolor="white",
                          linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.85, zorder=4)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(cx, cy, node["label"], ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=fontsize, color="white", fontweight="bold",
            fontfamily="serif", zorder=5)
    if node["val"] and isinstance(node["val"], (int, float)):
        ax.text(cx, cy - h/2 - 0.5, f"{node['val']} GB",
                ha="center", va="top", fontsize=6.5,
                color=COLORS["text_tertiary"], fontfamily="serif", zorder=5)


def flow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, vol, max_vol=980, color="#aaaaaa", alpha=0.25):
    lw = max(0.5, min(9, 8.5 * (vol / max_vol) ** 0.5))
    arr = FancyArrowPatch(
        posA=(x1, y1), posB=(x2, y2),
        connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.10",
        arrowstyle="-",
        color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=2,
    )
    ax.add_patch(arr)


# ── Background bands ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
band_defs = [
    ("source",      LAYER_X["source"],      COLORS["source"]),
    ("ingestion",   LAYER_X["ingestion"],   COLORS["ingestion"]),
    ("bronze",      LAYER_X["bronze"],      COLORS["bronze"]),
    ("silver",      LAYER_X["silver"],      COLORS["silver"]),
    ("gold",        LAYER_X["gold"],        COLORS["gold"]),
    ("consumption", LAYER_X["consumption"], COLORS["consumption"]),
]
bw = 14
for _, cx, col in band_defs:
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((cx - bw/2, GOV_Y - GOV_H/2 - 1),
                          bw, NODE_AREA_TOP - (GOV_Y - GOV_H/2 - 1) + 11,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.2",
                          facecolor=col, edgecolor="none",
                          alpha=0.07, zorder=0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)

# ── Layer header labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
header_y = 93
headers = [
    (LAYER_X["source"],      "SOURCES\n(10 systems)",    COLORS["source"]),
    (LAYER_X["ingestion"],   "INGESTION",                COLORS["ingestion"]),
    (LAYER_X["bronze"],      "BRONZE\nRaw Zone",          COLORS["bronze"]),
    (LAYER_X["silver"],      "SILVER\nCurated Zone",      COLORS["silver"]),
    (LAYER_X["gold"],        "GOLD\nBusiness Zone",       COLORS["gold"]),
    (LAYER_X["consumption"], "CONSUMPTION\n(6 endpoints)",COLORS["consumption"]),
]
for hx, htxt, hcol in headers:
    ax.text(hx, header_y, htxt, ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=8, fontfamily="serif", color=hcol,
            fontweight="bold", multialignment="center", zorder=6)

# ── Draw flows ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def node_by_label(nodes, label):
    for n in nodes:
        if n["label"] == label:
            return n
    raise KeyError(label)

# Source → Ingestion
src_ing = [
    ("IoT Sensors",     "Stream Ingestion", 450, "streaming"),
    ("App Logs",        "Stream Ingestion", 320, "streaming"),
    ("Web Clickstream", "Stream Ingestion", 210, "streaming"),
    ("Market Data",     "Stream Ingestion",  35, "streaming"),
    ("ERP System",      "Batch Ingestion",  120, "batch"),
    ("CRM Platform",    "Batch Ingestion",   85, "batch"),
    ("Social Media",    "Batch Ingestion",   60, "batch"),
    ("File Shares",     "Batch Ingestion",   45, "batch"),
    ("Legacy RDBMS",    "CDC Connector",     95, "cdc"),
    ("NoSQL Stores",    "CDC Connector",    140, "cdc"),
]
for sl, il, vol, mode in src_ing:
    s = node_by_label(src_nodes, sl)
    i = node_by_label(ing_nodes, il)
    flow(ax, s["cx"] + s["w"]/2, s["cy"],
             i["cx"] - i["w"]/2, i["cy"],
             vol, color=mode_colors[mode], alpha=0.20)

# Ingestion → Bronze
ing_brz = [
    ("Stream Ingestion", "Raw Log Data",     530),
    ("Stream Ingestion", "Raw IoT Events",   450),
    ("Batch Ingestion",  "Raw Transactions", 300),
    ("Batch Ingestion",  "Raw External",      95),
    ("Stream Ingestion", "Raw External",      35),
    ("CDC Connector",    "Raw DB Snapshots", 185),
]
for il, bl, vol in ing_brz:
    i = node_by_label(ing_nodes, il)
    b = node_by_label(brz_nodes, bl)
    flow(ax, i["cx"] + i["w"]/2, i["cy"],
             b["cx"] - b["w"]/2, b["cy"],
             vol, color=COLORS["bronze"], alpha=0.22)

# Bronze → Silver
brz_slv = [
    ("Raw IoT Events",   "Cleaned IoT Metrics",   180),
    ("Raw Transactions", "Enriched Transactions", 110),
    ("Raw Log Data",     "Sessionized Clicks",      90),
    ("Raw Transactions", "Unified Customer 360",    25),
    ("Raw DB Snapshots", "Unified Customer 360",    20),
    ("Raw External",     "Norm. Market Data",       20),
]
for bl, sl, vol in brz_slv:
    b = node_by_label(brz_nodes, bl)
    s = node_by_label(slv_nodes, sl)
    flow(ax, b["cx"] + b["w"]/2, b["cy"],
             s["cx"] - s["w"]/2, s["cy"],
             vol, color=COLORS["silver"], alpha=0.28)

# Silver → Gold
slv_gld = [
    ("Cleaned IoT Metrics",    "Anomaly Features",    12),
    ("Enriched Transactions",  "Revenue Aggregates",   8),
    ("Enriched Transactions",  "Product Perf. KPIs",   5),
    ("Sessionized Clicks",     "Marketing Attr.",       4),
    ("Unified Customer 360",   "Customer LTV",          3),
]
for sl, gl, vol in slv_gld:
    s = node_by_label(slv_nodes, sl)
    g = node_by_label(gld_nodes, gl)
    flow(ax, s["cx"] + s["w"]/2, s["cy"],
             g["cx"] - g["w"]/2, g["cy"],
             vol, color=COLORS["gold"], alpha=0.35)

# Gold → Consumption (fixed vol=4 since queries have no GB)
gld_con = [
    ("Revenue Aggregates",  "Executive Dashboards"),
    ("Product Perf. KPIs",  "Executive Dashboards"),
    ("Customer LTV",        "Executive Dashboards"),
    ("Revenue Aggregates",  "Ad-hoc SQL Analytics"),
    ("Marketing Attr.",     "Ad-hoc SQL Analytics"),
    ("Anomaly Features",    "ML Training Pipelines"),
    ("Customer LTV",        "ML Training Pipelines"),
    ("Anomaly Features",    "ML Serving Endpoints"),
    ("Product Perf. KPIs",  "Data API Services"),
    ("Customer LTV",        "Reverse ETL to SaaS"),
    ("Marketing Attr.",     "Reverse ETL to SaaS"),
]
for gl, cl in gld_con:
    g = node_by_label(gld_nodes, gl)
    c = node_by_label(con_nodes, cl)
    flow(ax, g["cx"] + g["w"]/2, g["cy"],
             c["cx"] - c["w"]/2, c["cy"],
             3, max_vol=980, color=COLORS["consumption"], alpha=0.28)

# ── Draw nodes (after flows so nodes sit on top) ───────────────────────────────
for n in src_nodes:
    draw_node(ax, n, COLORS["source"],      fontsize=7.5)
for n in ing_nodes:
    draw_node(ax, n, COLORS["ingestion"],   fontsize=8)
for n in brz_nodes:
    draw_node(ax, n, COLORS["bronze"],      fontsize=8)
for n in slv_nodes:
    draw_node(ax, n, COLORS["silver"],      fontsize=7.5)
for n in gld_nodes:
    draw_node(ax, n, COLORS["gold"],        fontsize=7.5)
for n in con_nodes:
    draw_node(ax, n, COLORS["consumption"], fontsize=7.5)

# ── Transformation badges ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
badges = [
    (LAYER_X["bronze"], "23 transforms · 3 types · low",  COLORS["bronze"]),
    (LAYER_X["silver"], "34 transforms · 5 types · high", COLORS["silver"]),
    (LAYER_X["gold"],   "30 transforms · 4 types · high", COLORS["gold"]),
]
badge_y = 19
for bx, btxt, bcol in badges:
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((bx - 7, badge_y - 1.4), 14, 2.8,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.25",
                          facecolor=bcol, edgecolor="white",
                          linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.88, zorder=6)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(bx, badge_y, btxt, ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=7, color="white", fontfamily="serif", zorder=7)

# ── Governance strip ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gy0 = GOV_Y - GOV_H/2
gov_rect = FancyBboxPatch((2, gy0), 96, GOV_H,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=0.2",
                           facecolor=COLORS["governance"], edgecolor=COLORS["governance"],
                           linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.09, zorder=0)
ax.add_patch(gov_rect)

ax.text(3.5, GOV_Y + 0.5, "DATA GOVERNANCE & LINEAGE  ─  15 controls, spanning all pipeline stages",
        ha="left", va="center",
        fontsize=8, color=COLORS["governance"], fontfamily="serif",
        fontweight="bold", zorder=5)

gov_layer_data = [
    (LAYER_X["ingestion"],   "2",  "Schema Validation\nQuality Gate"),
    (LAYER_X["bronze"],      "2",  "Immutable Audit Log\nPII Detection"),
    (LAYER_X["silver"],      "3",  "Col. Encryption\nLineage Capture\nRow-Level Security"),
    (LAYER_X["gold"],        "3",  "RBAC Control\nData Certification\nUsage Tracking"),
    (LAYER_X["consumption"], "2",  "Token-Based Auth\nRate Limiting"),
]
for gx, cnt, lbl in gov_layer_data:
    circle = plt.Circle((gx, GOV_Y - 0.8), 1.5,
                         color=COLORS["governance"], alpha=0.78, zorder=5)
    ax.add_patch(circle)
    ax.text(gx, GOV_Y - 0.8, cnt, ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=9, color="white", fontfamily="serif",
            fontweight="bold", zorder=6)
    ax.text(gx, gy0 - 0.4, lbl, ha="center", va="top",
            fontsize=5.8, color=COLORS["governance"], fontfamily="serif",
            zorder=5, multialignment="center")

ax.text(96, GOV_Y - 0.8, "+3 cross-layer\n(Lineage, Tags\nCompliance)",
        ha="right", va="center", fontsize=6.5,
        color=COLORS["governance"], fontfamily="serif", zorder=5,
        multialignment="right")

# ── Volume reduction annotation ───────────────────────────────────────────────
arr_y = 4.5
ax.annotate("", xy=(LAYER_X["gold"] - 2, arr_y),
            xytext=(LAYER_X["source"] + 2, arr_y),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=COLORS["text_tertiary"], lw=0.9),
            zorder=5)
ax.text((LAYER_X["source"] + LAYER_X["gold"]) / 2, arr_y - 0.3,
        "1,560 GB  →  445 GB  →  32 GB   (98% volume reduction through medallion refinement)",
        ha="center", va="top", fontsize=8.5,
        color=COLORS["text_secondary"], fontfamily="serif", style="italic", zorder=5)

# ── Flow mode legend ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
leg_x, leg_y = 34, 96.5
ax.text(leg_x - 1, leg_y, "Flow mode:", ha="right", va="center",
        fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS["text_secondary"], fontfamily="serif")
for i, (lbl, col) in enumerate([("Streaming", "#4e79a7"),
                                  ("Batch",     "#76b7b2"),
                                  ("CDC / Near-RT", "#f28e2b")]):
    lx = leg_x + i * 11
    ax.plot([lx, lx + 2.5], [leg_y, leg_y],
            color=col, lw=3, solid_capstyle="round", zorder=5)
    ax.text(lx + 3, leg_y, lbl, va="center",
            fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS["text_secondary"], fontfamily="serif")

# ── Title ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.50, 0.97,
         "Lakehouse Pipeline: 1,560 GB Daily Input Distils to 32 GB Business-Ready Gold",
         ha="center", va="top",
         fontsize=16.5, fontfamily="serif", color=COLORS["text"])
fig.text(0.50, 0.934,
         "End-to-end flow across 10 sources  ·  Bronze / Silver / Gold medallion layers  ·  6 consumption endpoints  ·  15 governance controls",
         ha="center", va="top",
         fontsize=10, fontfamily="serif", color=COLORS["text_secondary"], style="italic")

# ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=150,
            bbox_inches="tight", facecolor=COLORS["bg"])
print("Done → /app/output/result.png")
